pinned_at_note: Review-repair anchor for PR #108: parent head of the repair commit. The protected blobs below are the exact bytes of the repair head built on top of this anchor (blob self-reference precludes pinning the repair commit itself).
justification: PR #108 production-readiness review (owner comment 2026-09-15) authorizes these protected-path repairs: (1) integration receipt schema stays factory-integration-receipt-v2 and VerificationResult.to_dict() no longer mutates the canonical v2 signed payload in place — the typed timeout outcome is encoded through the already-versioned v2 fields (status/termination_reason/returncode 124); (2) the lease-unknown gate now uses ONE absolute monotonic deadline that includes the first lease read, with every SQLite busy budget capped at the remaining deadline; (3) ProcessControl.kill() on reap timeout no longer sets stopped for an unreaped process (stopped-implies-reaped invariant restored; typed reap_timed_out event and reap_timeout reason preserved); (4) lease read state+diagnostic are returned atomically via the typed LeaseRead result — the journal-global mutable lease_read_diag provenance channel is removed; (5) the trusted-fixture lane returns the deterministic timeout returncode 124 (SANDBOX_TIMEOUT_EXIT), matching the isolated lane; (6) journal read paths (observations/attempts) use a bounded contention-safe connection model (5s busy budget + bounded retry, no lock-sensitive write pragmas on readers), repairing the CI 'database is locked' failure of run 34940491451. tests/test_factory_* updates re-pin the watchdog/lease patch points (lease_read replaces lease_state; adjusted fake-clock tick budget for the first in-deadline read) and assert the frozen v2 payload. No other trust-surface semantics changed; PR #96 ProcessControl/started_persisted semantics preserved.
